## The problem
What's missing today? When does the current app fall short for you?

## What you want instead
Describe the behaviour or UI you'd expect.

## Alternatives considered
What other approaches did you think about?

## Out-of-scope check

This project is deliberately scope-limited. The following are NOT in scope and will be closed unless there is a compelling case:

- **Distraction detection** (head turning away from screen) — different product semantics, would require its own alert mode
- **Gaze tracking / heatmaps** — different product entirely, see roadmap for the sibling project idea
- **Cloud sync / cross-device** — violates the local-only privacy guarantee
- **Wearable IMU integration** — webcam is the deliberate constraint
- **Adaptive/rolling baseline** — known to drift over time, manual recalibration is the deliberate trade-off
- **Backend / server-side anything** — there is no backend

If your idea touches any of the above, please open a Discussion first instead of an issue.

## Roadmap items
If your idea matches a roadmap item in the README, link it here so we don't duplicate.
